services.name: Pilates Northwest
services.desc: Liz began Pilates certification training after a decade as a dedicated Pilates client. Having completed the rigorous STOTT PILATES® Matwork and Reformer training, Liz is now moving toward receiving her comprehensive Pilates certification through STOTT PILATES®, with a completion date in 2024. After many years spent practicing Pilates and engaging in a successful career as a stylist and salon owner, her natural next step was to pursue her passion for Pilates and become a certified Pilates instructor.
